answer: Work waits on the voyage until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the basalt of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the horizon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
